license_required.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of optometry or hold himself or herself out to the public in this State as being qualified to practice optometry or use in connection with that person's name, or otherwise assume or use, any title or description conveying or tending to convey the impression that the person is qualified to practice optometry, unless such person has been duly licensed under this chapter.

exams.notes: Must include diagnosis, treatment, and management of ocular disease; approved by the Division of Professional Regulation; administered at least once each year

required.quote: In the event that any optometrist licensed in this State fails to meet continuing education requirements, that optometrist's license shall lapse, and not be eligible for renewal, at the end of the licensing period in which the requirements were not met.

available.quote: The Board shall waive the internship requirement for an applicant holding a valid license to practice optometry issued by another jurisdiction and who has practiced for a minimum of 5 years in such other jurisdiction with standards of licensure which are equal to or greater than those of this chapter and grant a license by reciprocity to such applicant.

requirements.value: Must hold a valid license from another jurisdiction, have practiced for at least 5 years in that jurisdiction under standards equal to or greater than Delaware's, contact the National Practitioner Data Bank for verification, and obtain certified statements from all jurisdictions where licensed regarding any disciplinary proceedings or unresolved complaints.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced optometry in a merchandising store
Practiced in an office not exclusively devoted to optometry or other health care profession where unrelated merchandise is displayed, or in a store not conforming to professional standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practiced in an office not exclusively devoted to the practice of optometry or other health care profession, where material or merchandise is displayed pertaining to a business or commercial undertaking not bearing any relation to the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continued in the employ of or acted as assistant to a person, firm, or corporation violating Delaware optometry laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continued in the employ of, or acted as an assistant to, any person, firm or corporation, either directly or indirectly, after the optometrist has knowledge that such person, firm or corporation is violating the laws of Delaware concerning the practice of optometry;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicited for ophthalmic materials or optometric services involving kickback arrangements or financial remuneration to induce referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicited in person or through an agent or agents for the purpose of selling ophthalmic materials or optometric services which involves any form of kickback arrangement or where financial remuneration or payment in kind is made to a nonpractitioner to induce referral business from that nonpractitioner;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted use of the optometrist's name or title by an unlicensed person or entity in advertising, unless in conjunction with a Board-approved vision service plan
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Caused or permitted the use of that optometrist's name, profession or professional title by or in conjunction with any association, company, corporation or unlicensed person in any advertising of any manner, unless in conjunction with a vision service plan approved by the Board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced for or in conjunction with a corporation or company except as allowed under Chapter 6 of Title 8
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practiced for or in conjunction with, either directly or indirectly, a corporation or company, except that allowed under Chapter 6 of Title 8;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed or cooperated in fraud or material deception to acquire a license; impersonated another licensee; or aided an unlicensed person to represent themselves as an optometrist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employed or knowingly cooperated in fraud or material deception in order to acquire a license as an optometrist; has impersonated another person holding a license or allowed another person to use that optometrist's license; or aided or abetted a person not licensed as an optometrist to represent oneself as an optometrist;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been convicted of a crime substantially related to the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of a crime that is substantially related to the practice of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Excessively used or abused drugs, including alcohol, narcotics, or chemicals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Excessively used or abused drugs (including alcohol, narcotics or chemicals);

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in consumer fraud or deception, restraint of competition, or price-fixing activities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in an act of consumer fraud or deception; engaged in the restraint of competition; or participated in price-fixing activities;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had license suspended, revoked, or other disciplinary action taken by licensing authority in another jurisdiction for conduct that would constitute grounds for discipline in Delaware
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had that optometrist's license, certification or registration as an optometrist suspended or revoked or other disciplinary action taken by the appropriate licensing authority in another jurisdiction;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to notify the Board that the optometrist's license in another state has been subject to discipline, surrender, suspension, or revocation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to notify the Board that the optometrist's license, certification or registration as an optometrist in another state has been subject to discipline or has been surrendered, suspended or revoked.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in illegal, negligent, or unethical conduct in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in illegal, negligent or unethical conduct in the practice of optometry; or

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any provision of the optometry chapter or any rule or regulation of the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated any provision of this chapter or any rule or regulation of the Board.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of optometry" means the examination or measurement by any subjective or objective means including automated or testing devices for the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of conditions of the human eye, lid, adnexa, and visual system as outlined below.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of optometry" means the examination or measurement by any subjective or objective means including automated or testing devices for the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of conditions of the human eye, lid, adnexa, and visual system as outlined below.

value: Use, adapting, and fitting of all types of lenses or devices
Dispensing of contact lenses pursuant to a written prescription
Determination of refractive error or visual, muscular, or anatomical anomalies of the eye
Provision or prescription of vision therapy, low-vision rehabilitation, or developmental or perceptual therapy
Minor procedures on the surface of the skin of the ocular adnexa, cornea and conjunctiva
Use of pharmaceutical agents for diagnosis and treatment of diseases, disorders, and conditions of the eye and adnexa
Prescription of controlled substances (Schedule II Hydrocodone, Schedules III-V) with 72-hour supply limit
Prescription of oral steroid limited to a single 6-day methylprednisolone dose pack
Use of epinephrine auto-injector to counteract anaphylaxis
methods_authorized.quote: "Practice of optometry" includes all of the following: Use, adapting, and fitting of all types of lenses or devices ... Dispensing of any type of contact lenses ... Determination of refractive error or visual, muscular, or anatomical anomalies of the eye. Provision or prescription of vision therapy, low-vision rehabilitation, or developmental or perceptual therapy.

drug_authority.value: Includes use of pharmaceutical agents for diagnosis and treatment of eye and adnexa conditions; may prescribe Schedule II (Hydrocodone, 72-hr limit), III, IV, V controlled substances (72-hr limit), oral steroids (single 6-day methylprednisolone dose pack); excludes oral immunosuppressives (except oral steroids), oral antifungals, oral antimetabolites, IV/injectable substances, and medications solely for systemic conditions.
drug_authority.quote: Includes the use of pharmaceutical agents for the diagnosis and treatment of diseases, disorders, and conditions of the eye and adnexa based on the licensing requirement that satisfies the requirement for graduate level coursework that includes general and ocular pharmacology
